top_deficiency_types.title: Develop and implement a complete care plan that meets all the resident's needs, with timetables and actions that can be measured.
top_deficiency_types.category: Resident Assessment and Care Planning Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Provide appropriate pressure ulcer care and prevent new ulcers from developing.
top_deficiency_types.category: Quality of Life and Care Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Allow residents to self-administer drugs if determined clinically appropriate.
Honor the resident's right to a safe, clean, comfortable and homelike environment, including but not limited to receiving treatment and supports for daily living safely.
Provide and implement an infection prevention and control program.
Have an enclosure around a vertical opening shaft.
Have properly installed electrical wiring and gas equipment.
Not transfer or discharge a resident without an adequate reason; and must provide documentation and convey specific information  when a resident is transferred or discharged.
Develop the complete care plan within 7 days of the comprehensive assessment; and prepared, reviewed, and revised by a team of health professionals.
top_deficiency_types.category: Resident Assessment and Care Planning Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Provide appropriate care for a resident to maintain and/or improve range of motion (ROM), limited ROM and/or mobility, unless a decline is for a medical reason.
top_deficiency_types.category: Quality of Life and Care Deficiencies
